steps.say: Tricky words have a part you cannot spell just by listening.
Find the tricky part. Say the word in a funny way to remember it.
Some words have a silent letter. Climb has a silent b.
Some words sound the same but mean different things.
Use look, say, cover, write and check to practise.

hints: All four try to spell the same word.
Say it in a funny way: peo-ple.
The middle has e and o together.
check.explanation: People is spelt p, e, o, p, l, e.

options.why: People has eo in the middle.
